language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.

dialog.text: Hello, my name is Chip!
Hi, I am Adrian.
I play the charango for a street orchestra. We are going to be playing today.
Right now only 20% of my band is here. I am waiting for the rest of them to arrive.
Percent means out of one hundred or part of a whole. There are 5 people in Adrian's band.
We are trying to answer the question, what percent of the band is here?
When only Adrian is there, 1 out of 5 people are present. As a fraction we would say 1/5th of the band is here.
To express this fraction as a percent we will multiply the result by one hundred.
So, the first 20% of the band is here and we are waiting for the other 80% to arrive.
Now 40% of my band is here.
When 1 more person arrives, 2/5ths of the band is here.
So, now 40% of the band is here and so on.
80% of the band is here.
We are waiting for the last 20%.
100% of the orchestra is here.
Let us go pick up our instruments. Do you want to come with us?
